cohort: 13,663 primiparous women in Slovenia who gave birth between 2008-2012
finding: Adolescent pregnancy was associated with increased rates of adverse pregnancy and birth outcomes, including preterm labor, low birth weight, and small for gestational age, compared to women aged 20-24 years.
mod_finding: Spontaneous labor was more common in adolescents, while emergency and elective Caesarean sections were less common than in women aged 20-24 years.
birth_weight: Low birth weight newborns were more common in adolescent pregnancies
